title: KAITO — The Ultimate Performance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Thank you for coming to see my show today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, I'd like to get things started right away by introducing myself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's all work together to make this our dream show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Audience Member
rows.Line: We're ready!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't take your eyes off me for even a second. Because I'm KAITO! Your idol!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all for cheering so loudly!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Today's show has a very special place in my heart.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I couldn't be happier that I get to spend this time with all of you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's jump in with our first song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! Listen to KAITO!
His voice is so beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You and the others helped produce this show, right, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's right. We wanted to show our appreciation for him, since he's always helping us with our shows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Louder, everyone! I know you can do better than that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is incredible...
It's still only the first song, but the crowd's bouncing off the walls.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And the lighting effects are very cool!
They're all following him as he moves.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Miku came up with that.
She isn't here right now because she's helping out backstage.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
It's like KAITO's the one commanding all those lights to move!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, these effects really feel like they're meant just for him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, for our next song, I'll be asking a special guest to join me on stage! Let's call his name together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. He's our very own Prince Charming... Can you guess who I'm talking about? Ready?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len!

rows.Speaker: Audience Member
rows.Line: Len!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
I'm Kagamine Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I get to help KAITO with his show today, because he always does so much for us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I could say the same for you.
So, thank you for being here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, we'll be singing our next song together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, they're doing such a cool dance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a pretty complicated routine with a lot of tempo changes. And they're doing it without breaking a sweat... I'm amazed, but not surprised.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The way they're moving in perfect sync makes it feel so powerful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's a very dynamic dance.
Len spent quite a lot of time coming up with it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: He said he wanted to show the audience just how cool and great a leader KAITO is.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How cool and great a leader he is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, KAITO's moving with authority, but also with grace. This dance is a representation of who he is.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: He's shining more brightly today than ever.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(That's ten songs already...
And the next one is my last. Time really flew by...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Each song means so much to me too...
This has been such a joyful occasion for me.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(I don't want it to end just yet.
I want it to keep going for a bit longer...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...!
I'm just so happy... I couldn't help but savor this moment for a bit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So, everyone!
Thank you all again for coming to see my show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once more, this has a very special place in my heart!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because Miku and the others all worked incredibly hard to make it happen!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have all these wonderful people around me who I want to see shine on stage when they perform...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But they wanted me to shine today. They did so much, just for me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And thanks to them, we got to enjoy this incredible show together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: With this last song, I want to express my gratitude to everyone here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Stick with me until the end, everyone.
